main.description: Get the HLS CMAF init segment (ftyp+moov) for a specific track of a video. Returns a single-track init segment suitable for use as an EXT-X-MAP in HLS media playlists.

rkey.description: Record key of the place.stream.video record.

track.description: Track ID to get the init segment for.

errors.name: VideoNotFound
errors.description: No video record found for this DID and rkey.

errors.name: TrackNotFound
errors.description: No track with this ID found in the video.
